claims.claim_text: For Koski, the hut key is no longer in the box by the door. As far as I know it is now held at the caretaker's office, so call ahead and they will meet you, and phone the monitoring desk before you open up because the door contact raises an alarm. Allow an extra half hour on the first visit.
